title: Runner's Pasta with Pesto
description: A quick and nutritious Italian-inspired pasta dish made with pesto sauce, ideal for runners after a workout.

ingredients.name: Pasta
ingredients.notes: Choose whole wheat for added nutrition

ingredients.name: Runner beans
ingredients.notes: Trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat a tablespoon of water over medium heat.
Add the runner beans and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Stir in the pesto sauce and Italian seasoning (if using).
Combine the cooked pasta and pesto mixture. Toss to coat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
